operationEnvelope.presentInvalidOrUnknownOperation: reader-only unsupported row; never coerce, execute, retry, reorder, open, or delete as an image enhancement

sourceSelectionV1.absent: use sourceId as the indexed Original source
sourceSelectionV1.present: resolve exactly one succeeded photoreal job for the same indexed Original; the client never supplies its managed output path
producerRequirements: status is succeeded and outputPath is present
producer sourceId, sourcePath, and sourceSignature match the indexed Original
output passes lexical and canonical managed-root ownership checks
output is an existing supported still image
sourceSelectionV1.persistedIdentity: sourceId, sourcePath, and sourceSignature remain the Original catalog identity; sourceProducerJobId records the optional photoreal input provenance
sourceSelectionV1.retry: preserve sourceProducerJobId and revalidate the producer immediately before execution
sourceSelectionV1.deletion: do not delete a photoreal output while a queued or running i2i job depends on its producer id

seed.missing: choose once at enqueue and persist the resolved integer

requestV1.normalization: trim each string without rewriting its wording

snapshotV1.unknownFields: preserve when a compatible writer rewrites the row
snapshotV1.retry: reuse the complete persisted preset, prompt, seed, and source provenance

promptSemanticsV1.style: positive description of the requested end state
promptSemanticsV1.requestedChanges: describe the requested hair color and optional normalized hair-color details; do not inherit a private prompt from the source producer
promptSemanticsV1.sourceReference: the exact selected Original or photoreal producer pixels are the image reference; source provenance is preserved separately from prompt text
promptSemanticsV1.identity: retain the same recognizable person, face geometry and proportions, expression, gaze, age, skin appearance, and unrequested facial details
promptSemanticsV1.unchangedContext: retain pose, body proportions, hands, camera, crop, background, lighting, visual medium, and every unrequested detail
promptSemanticsV1.pixelIdenticalFaceGuarantee: the deterministic composite restores the protected face core and every pixel outside the editable hair mask from the exact selected source before output encoding

executionV1.source: resolve and revalidate the exact selected source before processing
executionV1.selection: derive the target and protected region automatically; v1 accepts no manual mask
executionV1.queue: run through the single durable Enhancement queue
executionV1.publication: publish one managed output only after protected and out-of-target regions pass validation
executionV1.failClosed: publish no output when the target, protected region, exact source, or composite invariant cannot be established

capabilityV1.enqueueGate: POST operation=i2i requires readerReady, writerEnabled, backendConfigured, and ready to all be exactly true and target to be listed in supportedTargets
capabilityV1.notReady: validate the request and source envelope, then return 503 I2I_BACKEND_NOT_READY without writing a job or waking the queue
capabilityV1.passiveRead: health, Jobs readers, and version readers never load models or start the worker

readerRules.missingCapability: keep jobs readable but hide or disable new i2i enqueue actions
readerRules.malformedSnapshot: reader-only protected row; never execute, retry, reorder, open, or delete through a managed-image mutation path
readerRules.unknownSnapshotFields: ignore for display and preserve on compatible rewrite
readerRules.passiveUi: opening menus, boards, source selectors, Jobs, or versions never starts the companion or enqueues work

readerFirst.writerRule: enable an i2i writer only after every active reader accepts i2i rows
readerFirst.rollback: after an i2i row exists, retain an i2i-capable reader even if enqueue is disabled
